item.title: Greek Aircraft and Tanks Coming in Sky Odyssey!
item.description:
Introducing Greece’s Air and Ground Forces Sub-Trees!

The upcoming Sky Odyssey major update for War Thunder will introduce Greek aviation and ground vehicle sub-trees to Israel’s tech tree! Both of these countries have a long history of comprehensive military cooperation. Let’s take a look at some of the most interesting Greek vehicles coming in the next update, starting with aviation.
